# Packing list

For a day hike: water (at least one litre for every two hours), a rain jacket, a warm layer, sun cream, a map or an offline track, a first-aid kit, a headlamp and food that survives a squashed backpack. Wear boots that are broken in, and carry spare socks. Check [[Hiking/weather]] the evening before.
